title: CDA ApprovedPlan
description: Output of commands/approve-plan.ps1 (New-ApprovedPlan in src/adopter/lib/Approval.psm1) -- the HUMAN APPROVAL artifact. Immutable once written: commands/apply-plan.ps1 refuses to run against a plan whose recomputed planHash does not match the stored value (tamper detection -- see docs/artifact-model.md, 'Plan hash contract'). Never produced by any mutating call; this is pure data transformation from an Assessment.

stateFingerprint.description: Carried through verbatim from the source assessment -- see assessment.schema.json's own stateFingerprint definition. Re-read live and compared against by commands/apply-plan.ps1's pre-flight before any mutation (stale-plan protection).

planHash.description: Deterministic SHA-256 hex digest over a canonical JSON projection of {repository, profile, operations[]} -- see docs/artifact-model.md, 'Plan hash contract' for exactly which operation fields are included/excluded.

destructive.description: Independent safety property -- see docs/safety-model.md, 'Destructive operations registry'. A destructive operation can be approved ONLY via an explicit per-id -ApproveOperation, never via -ApproveSafeChanges, regardless of its classification.

dependencies.description: Human-readable preconditions this operation depends on; the EXECUTABLE re-check of each lives in src/adopter/lib/Apply.psm1's Test-OperationPreconditions, keyed by the same operation id.
